text: A woman with long, flowing red hair and orange eyes stands in a white, draped garment open at the front, revealing her torso. She wears a blue beaded choker and belt, and bracelets on wrists. Her skin is pale, face oval-shaped. She poses with arms slightly outstretched, hands open. Behind her, a stone floor has glowing circular symbols. In background: shelves hold dark vessels. No other figures are visible.
